SASBDB entry SASDRN5  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDRN5/)

Publication: Structural and functional analysis of a plant nucleolar RNA chaperone-like protein
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-023-36426-4

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDRN5/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
